shortDescription: The Newsletter Registration section provides a dedicated area for email list signups, typically placed in footer regions. It includes heading, subline, email input with custom placeholder, submit button, and legal text for GDPR compliance. Status messages for loading, success, error, and neutral states are fully customizable with optional emojis or icons. An accompanying image can enhance visual appeal. Background colors and text adapt to various theme contexts.
